heading: Friday, April 24, 2026
topLine: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-V4 preview with 1M-token context.

items.headline: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-V4 preview with 1M-token context
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4 Preview comprises V4-Pro (1.6T total, 49B active parameters) and V4-Flash (284B total, 13B active), both open-weight with 1M-token context and thinking/non-thinking modes. DeepSeek claims V4-Pro leads open models on agentic coding, math and STEM benchmarks; both are live in the app and API.
